scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/api && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/api && npm run test --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/api && npm run lint --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.clean: rimraf packages/api/dist packages/ui/dist packages/api/node_modules packages/ui/node_modules node_modules
